title: What's New: Enhanced Subscription Billing Analytics (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Enhanced Subscription Billing Analytics
Power BI Subscription Billing App Redesign
Updated Power BI Reports and Visuals
New Demo Data for Subscription Billing

features.name: Unified Power BI Subscription Billing UI
features.description: Reworked the subscription billing Power BI app UI to match the look and feel of the other eight Power BI apps, creating a consistent user experience across the platform.

features.name: Subscription Billing Overview Report Redesign
features.description: Updated the subscription billing overview report with new visual design and layout, matching version 28 standards with improved presentation of data.

features.name: Revenue Year-over-Year Growth Report with Tooltips
features.description: Modified the revenue year-over-year growth report to include visual type enhancements and tooltips for additional detail without changing the underlying information.

features.name: Navigation Visuals for Report Filtering
features.description: Added navigation visuals to Power BI reports that allow users to filter data by clicking on chart elements instead of using traditional filter panes.

features.name: Visual Indicators in Matrix Reports
features.description: Added visual indicators to matrix reports to provide visual context alongside numeric values, showing the relative size and magnitude of data points.

features.name: Revenue Analysis Report Updates
features.description: Updated revenue analysis reports with navigational visuals to enable filtering through interactive chart elements.

features.name: Churn Analysis Report with Visual Filtering
features.description: Enhanced churn analysis report with easy-to-use visual filtering capabilities alongside traditional filter options.

features.name: Revenue by Item Bubble Charts
features.description: Introduced bubble chart visuals for revenue by item analysis, showing two-dimensional profitability metrics with bubble size representing an additional dimension.

features.name: Map Visuals for Geographic Revenue Analysis
features.description: Added map visuals to show revenue by customer and geography, consistent with similar features introduced in other Power BI apps in previous release waves.

features.name: Enhanced Subscription Billing Demo Data
features.description: Expanded demo data for subscription billing including more customer contracts, vendor contracts, and transactions to support better data storytelling in both Power BI and analysis mode views.
